body:
WHAT
Every `file_edited` event from the engine (a unified diff of one edit) is collected per file for the session. The Changes panel lists each changed file with edit count and +/- line counts, expands to show every diff, and offers an Undo that reverts the file's edits through the main process.

WHY
Without it the user cannot see what the agent changed across a session or take it back in one step.

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/events.js — sessionChanges Map and sessionChangeOrder, parseDiff(diff, fallbackPath), onFileEdited(event), resetChanges(), rebuildSessionChanges(), discardSessionFileChanges(relPath), renderChanges(). app/renderer/modules/workbench.js — sessionChangeTotals(), appendDiffCounts(), renderInspectorChanges(), renderInlineChangesCard(), renderReviewDrawer(preferredPath), openReviewDrawer(), undoFileChange(relPath) which calls window.magentra.undoChanges(relPath, change.diffs). app/main.js — ipcMain.handle("changes:undo") → undoWorkspaceDiffs(workspace, relPath, diffs) (app/main/changes.js).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Two file_edited events for the same relPath produce one row with count 2, adds/dels summed, and a detail block containing both diffs with '── edit 1 of 2 ──' / '── edit 2 of 2 ──' headers.
2. parseDiff extracts relPath from the '+++ b/<path>' line and counts '+'/'-' lines excluding the '---'/'+++' headers.
3. A diff without a '+++ b/' header falls back to event.path for the file name.
4. undoFileChange with a main-process reply { ok: true } removes that file from sessionChanges and appends a 'undid <path>' note; a reply { ok: false, error } leaves the entry in place and shows a sys error — the view never drops a change the disk still has.
5. resetChanges() (session start / clear) empties the map, hides the nav badge, and the summary reads 'no edits yet' / 'No changes yet'.
